extensionDescription.message: Delete browsing history for the domain in your current tab, with a preview. Other domains and subdomains are kept.

uiLanguage.description: Language code for the translated interface and fallback number formatting.

hostScope.message: Includes HTTP and HTTPS, all paths and ports on this domain. History for other domains and subdomains is kept.

deleteScope.message: Delete the browsing history for the domain shown above.

previewSummaryOne.message: $count$ entry for “$domain$” will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

previewSummaryOther.message: $count$ entries for “$domain$” will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

jobSkippedOne.message: $count$ entry skipped: no longer present or not eligible for deletion.

jobSkippedOther.message: $count$ entries skipped: no longer present or not eligible for deletion.

jobMayClose.message: You can close this menu. Cleanup will continue.

jobAllProcessed.message: All previewed entries have been processed.

footerNote.message: Cookies, website data and bookmarks are kept.

errorUnsupportedTab.message: Open a website with an HTTP or HTTPS address. Cleanup is not available for this tab.

errorTabChanged.message: The website in this tab has changed. Reopen the menu and create a new preview.

errorBusy.message: A cleanup is already running. Please wait for it to finish.

errorExpired.message: This preview has expired. Create a new preview before deleting.

errorInvalidRequest.message: The request could not be processed. Reopen the menu.

errorReadFailed.message: Your history could not be read completely. Please try again.

errorInterrupted.message: Cleanup was interrupted. The counts show the last known state. Create a new preview.

errorInternal.message: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
